comparisons.peer_topic: Issuance of Senior Unsecured Notes in 2024
comparisons.peer_summary: The company issued senior unsecured notes totaling $10 billion in 2024, with $5 billion issued in July and another $5 billion in October.
comparisons.comparison: Both AMD and Broadcom disclosed the issuance of senior unsecured notes as a primary debt instrument. AMD issued $1.0 billion in 2022 (disclosed in FY2024), whereas Broadcom issued $10 billion in 2024. Both issuances involve general unsecured senior obligations. AMD's notes carry interest rates of 3.924% and 4.393% with semi-annual payments, while Broadcom's $5 billion tranches issued in July and October 2024 are also senior unsecured notes.

The 3.924% Notes and 4.393% Notes are general unsecured senior obligations of the Company.
We issued senior unsecured notes for an aggregate principal amount of $5,000 million in October 2024 and $5,000 million in July 2024.

comparisons.peer_topic: Senior Notes Payment and Redemption Terms
comparisons.peer_summary: Fixed-rate senior notes pay interest semiannually and may be redeemed prior to maturity at specified prices subject to restrictions. These obligations rank equally with other senior unsecured indebtedness and effectively junior to subsidiary liabilities.
comparisons.comparison: Both AMD and Intel disclose the structural subordination and payment terms of their senior notes. AMD's notes are 'general unsecured senior obligations' implying they rank equally with other unsecured debt and junior to secured/subsidiary debt. Intel explicitly states its obligations 'rank equally in right of payment with all of our other existing and future senior unsecured indebtedness and will effectively rank junior to all liabilities of our subsidiaries.' Both entities also confirm semi-annual interest payments.

sentences.text: The 3.924% Notes and 4.393% Notes are general unsecured senior obligations of the Company.
The interest is payable semi-annually on June 1 and December 1 of each year, commencing on December 1, 2022.
Our fixed-rate senior notes pay interest semiannually.

The obligations under the notes rank equally in right of payment with all of our other existing and future senior unsecured indebtedness and will effectively rank junior to all liabilities of our subsidiaries.

comparisons.peer_topic: Seniority and Redemption Terms of Notes
comparisons.peer_summary: All notes are unsecured senior obligations, while subsidiary liabilities are effectively senior to them. Interest is paid semi-annually, and notes may be redeemed prior to maturity subject to a make-whole premium.
comparisons.comparison: Both AMD and NVIDIA characterize their senior notes as unsecured obligations with identical interest payment structures. AMD's notes are described as 'general unsecured senior obligations' with interest payable 'semi-annually'. Similarly, NVIDIA states its notes are 'unsecured senior obligations' and 'pay interest semi-annually'. Both companies also include covenants allowing redemption prior to maturity, though AMD explicitly references an indenture governing these terms.
